retryPolicy.otherFailures: every other failed send writes one failed receipt (Attempts 1) in Portal Outbox Receipts and is not re-sent automatically; the platform's default retry policy already retries a send within its run on a transient fault. Owner decision 2026-10-18 (supersedes rule A's reporting clause): every failure is registered; Folio_Failure_Watch reports the reportable groups (citizen outcomes, and any type it cannot place) to the registry hourly in working hours, each once, a burst as a broken mail connection, and the open ones at 07:00; the other groups are counted and shown in the Workspace's System Health.
retryPolicy.note: support-case closure notices keep their sweep retry (RN-027); owner rule A (2026-10-17) revised by the owner on 2026-10-18 as recorded in failureHandling

claimPolicy.note: recorded as policy; not built. Only one sweep is scheduled and the trigger sets no concurrency limit (owner, 2026-10-18: leave as is, no flow change)

reassignment.note: current behaviour: StaffNotices.reassigned (core/staff-notice-service.js, RN-019) goes to the registry mailbox while StaffNoticeDelivery.recipients is registry. Owner, 2026-10-18: leave as is, no change built

comments.note: current behaviour: comments send no mail (RN-020 is ABSENT). Owner, 2026-10-18: leave as is, the proposed comment notice is not built

sources.targets: current: Flow Configuration has no NOTIFY_ rows (live read 2026-10-17), so the flows use their built-in defaults: alerts to dgsRegistry@nitda.gov.ng, sweep digests to the registry (not staff), notices enabled, working hours only.
sources.claim: current: no claim step is built; the trigger sets no concurrency limit. proposed: concurrency 1, a flow change made only on approval.
sources.reassignment: proposed, not current behaviour: notify the new holder, not the previous one.
sources.comments: proposed, not current behaviour: comment notices to the assignee and the registry.
sources.statusMappings: current: config/status-vocabulary.config.js maps Accepted to review (Under review) and Archived to approved (Approved).

approvalBasis: Owner messages in the commissioning session: 2026-10-16 "All requested Approvals approved" and "Proposal accepted"; 2026-10-17 retry rule A; 2026-10-18 security and privacy owner confirmed as the Office of the DG/CEO, the three proposals (claim concurrency, reassignment, comments) left as is, all other approvals given.

failureHandling.principle: All failures are registered; not all are reported.
failureHandling.register: Portal Outbox Receipts (Global_Digital_Documents_Centre, 88a81ca1): every send of every released package writes Status sent or failed (tests/failure-register.test.mjs). A failure is closed by setting Status to resolved-resent, resolved-corrected or resolved-superseded; Modified and Modified By record who and when.
failureHandling.groups: config/notification-failure-groups.config.js: citizen (reported), codes, staff, ops, outward (registered and counted), unclassified (reported, fail-safe)
failureHandling.watch: Folio_Failure_Watch: every hour, Monday to Friday, 07:00-18:00 WAT; reports new reportable failures once; a burst (default 5 in the window) as a broken mail connection; at 07:00 the summary of open reportable failures with totals per group; writes NOTIFY_FAILURE_HEALTH for the Workspace.
failureHandling.controls: Flow Configuration NOTIFY_FAILURE_WATCH_ENABLED, NOTIFY_FAILURE_REPORT_GROUPS, NOTIFY_FAILURE_BURST, NOTIFY_FAILURE_REPORT_TO; registration itself cannot be switched off.
failureHandling.status: built in the repository (identification release of 2026-10-18); the flow is not yet created in the tenant
